title: US and Mexican Navy Seize More Than 1,200 Kilos of Cocaine off Oaxaca’s Coast; 6 Detained
author: César Arellano García
content:
_This article by[César Arellano
García](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/C%C3%A9sar%20Arellano%20Garc%C3%ADa)
originally appeared in the [October 12, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/10/12/sociedad/decomisan-mas-
de-mil-200-kilos-de-cocaina-frente-a-las-costas-de-oaxaca-hay-6-detenidos),
Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City**. The Secretariat of the Navy, in coordination with the United
States Coast Guard, seized a vessel carrying approximately **1,268 kilograms
of cocaine** off the coast of Oaxaca and detained its six crew members, the
federal Security Cabinet reported this Monday.

> [Post by @OHarfuch on
> X](https://twitter.com/OHarfuch/status/2109715113385328944)

The vessel was intercepted in international waters, **366 nautical miles south
of Huatulco** , during a maritime patrol and surveillance operation in which
air and surface units of the Mexican Navy took part.

According to the Security Cabinet, the seizure represents an estimated
economic loss of **289,104,000 pesos** for criminal groups and prevented
approximately 2,536,000 doses of drugs from reaching the population.

Aboard the vessel were 46 bundles containing approximately 1,268 kilograms of
presumed cocaine. The six crew members were detained and, after being informed
of their rights, were placed at the disposal of the competent authorities.

Both the vessel and the seized drugs were transferred to the facilities of the
Twenty-Second Naval Zone, in Puerto Chiapas, to later be handed over to the
Office of the Attorney General of the Republic (FGR), in coordination with the
Secretariat of Security and Citizen Protection (SSPC).

The FGR will determine the official weight of the seized substance, which will
be added to the **more than 90 tons of drugs** seized at sea by naval
personnel during the current administration.
